title: Diffusion control shared Mirror View plus sparse private residual (tiny denoiser mechanism screen)

random_selection.pool_rule: registry rows priority=P0 AND status=UNTESTED; exclude every ID with any live remote research/ma-* branch and every ID claimed by an existing experiment directory; registry order

selected_row.proposal: shared control View + sparse private condition residual
selected_row.logical_multiplicity: common controls with exceptional condition capacity
selected_row.mirror_delta: Quantify how much of diverse control behavior can be shared before private capacity is required.
selected_row.worker_note: Sweep control heterogeneity and residual rank.

hypothesis: On a structured family of spatial control residual operators attached to a frozen tiny diffusion denoiser, a shared basis plus per-condition multiplicative Mirror coordinates and a sparse private residual will preserve held-out control-residual fidelity with materially fewer total serialized bytes than independent condition branches; the private residual break point will rise as condition heterogeneity increases.
physical_object: One frozen tiny Stable Diffusion UNet plus one shared control adapter basis.
mirror_coordinate: A per-condition rank-r vector m applied multiplicatively to shared projected condition features before the shared adapter readout; optional one-rank sparse private convolutional residual.
logical_multiplicity: Condition-specific spatial residual functions added to the frozen UNet noise prediction.
prior_art_delta: Mechanism-level test of the MA-760 shared/private frontier, not a ControlNet/T2I-Adapter reproduction. Tiny checkpoint is an internal test fixture rather than a quality pretrained generator. No image-level generation quality claim.
controls: Frozen UNet with no control adapter
One hard-shared adapter across all condition identities
Independent per-condition full 3x3 convolutional adapters (upper control)
Shared additive low-rank adapter basis with condition coefficients
Multiplicative Mirror coordinate over the identical shared basis and code budget
Mirror coordinate plus rank-1 private convolutional residual

development.selection_metric: held-out control residual MSE and actual whole-library serialized bytes; paired against per-condition full adapters

paid_objects: frozen UNet state dict (counted once per library payload)

gates.development_pass: At some rho and rank, Mirror+top-8-private achieves held-out residual MSE <= 1.10x independent adapters, whole-library payload <= 0.95x independent, and shared-state marginal per-condition bytes <= 0.50x independent in both seeds. Mirror-specific value additionally requires >=5% MSE improvement over byte-matched additive low-rank control in both seeds.
gates.fail: No tested rho/rank meets quality and byte clauses, or Mirror fails matched simple-control clause at every feasible point.
gates.fresh_opening: Only if at least one development point passes all clauses in both seeds; otherwise fresh stays unopened.

training_protocol.optimizer: Closed-form float64 ridge/least-squares regression; no gradient updates. This is an explicit protocol deviation from the generic optimizer-update reporting template because all adapter and code models in this screen are linear operators.
training_protocol.data: Synthetic 3-channel spatial condition maps with generated 4x3x3x3 convolutional target operators. Actual frozen tiny UNet is invoked for integration/compute calibration; synthetic residual fidelity is the primary metric.
training_protocol.tuning_boundary: No hyperparameter changes after first development score; all preregistered rho/rank values reported.

boundaries: No ControlNet or T2I-Adapter architecture reproduction
Control residual fidelity on synthetic operators is mechanism evidence, not diffusion application validation
private_residual: Top-8 absolute kernel-coordinate residual entries per held-out condition, including integer indices and float32 values.
